summary: Build advanced HR business partner skills in workforce analytics, value creation, and executive reporting. Explore the five-day course.
lede: HR business partnering connects workforce decisions with organizational priorities and measurable outcomes. This training is for experienced HR professionals who advise leaders and need to assess workforce needs, analyze people data, and make evidence-based recommendations. It covers workforce metrics and scenario planning, talent-risk and succession assessment, and building business cases and executive reports that track outcomes.
audienceIntro: HR business partner training is intended for experienced people professionals who already advise leaders and now need stronger commercial, analytical, and strategic execution capability.
modules: Ulrich HRBP Model and Value Creation
Executive Reporting and HR Value Roadmaps
prerequisites: You should have substantial experience in HR business partnering, HR management, talent management, organizational development, or people analytics. You should be comfortable discussing workforce metrics, advising operational leaders, and interpreting basic financial or performance information. No coding is required. Advanced analytics and AI-assisted HR tools are covered at operational application level, not technical engineering level. Bring a current or representative workforce challenge for application during exercises.
